title: Crawler revamp, W9: Wikipedia's words kept only where its rule allows
why: decisions/0160 W9, review C13, decisions/0133 (the licence decides the use). A place looked up on demand (PlaceFinder) kept its Wikipedia summary whatever the source register said about Wikipedia; the page showing it already checked, but the text was stored. Now the summary is kept only when the register lets us keep Wikipedia's facts (Landmarks::wikiAllowed); otherwise the article's title and link are kept, as for landmarks. No database update. Summaries stored before are looked at in Phase 4.
